headline: UN rights chief warns Palestinians in Gaza face a real threat to existence
label: BREAKING
caption:
UN human rights chief Volker Turk issued a grave warning about the safety of Palestinians in Gaza and the occupied West Bank.

According to Turk, there is a growing risk of further atrocity crimes and he urged all states to take immediate action.

Turk cited inflammatory statements by senior Israeli officials advocating annexation, ethnic cleansing and collective punishment.

He stated that the incitement to hatred and violations amounting to war crimes has been appalling across society.

What actions can the international community take to protect civilians right now? 👇
